# AI code-generation targets

ISO-Tool documents two downstream systems as buildable AI-generated targets.

## Thamudic & Ancient Script Translation Engine

React/Next.js + Tailwind/Canvas, FastAPI, OpenCV, PyTorch/ViT or ResNet-18, FST transliteration, Semitic morphology, dictionary/Levenshtein lookup and manual RTL/LTR/boustrophedon glyph ordering are treated as an application workload with explicit image, ML, NLP and web dependencies.

## Chimera II runtime

C++/Rust runtime, lock-free rings, fixed-block memory pools, RMS/EDF scheduling, shared-memory zero-copy IPC, 8192-bit register emulation and WebAssembly visualization are treated as separate native/runtime artifact groups.

## AI generation policy

AI-generated source enters the same recursive scanner, dependency detector, compiler pipeline, provenance tracking and verification gates as human-authored source. AI output is never treated as trusted merely because it was generated by an AI model.
